verdict.rationale: Browserbase's Stagehand SDK advertises 'natural language selectors' (docs-5), and its Agents pull data from websites from natural-language goals (docs-8, docs-16). That covers the 'instead of writing selectors' half of the story. The evidence never shows a structured-extraction API with schemas or typed output; the URL-to-JSON fetch (docs-3) converts a page's format rather than following instructions. Missing for 10: an explicit natural-language extract capability with schema/structured output, depth documentation of extraction, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
